## Extended Figure 5a: Plotting rate of gene expression evolution from pseudobulks (with random resampling), expression cutoff = 0.5, human vs marmoset
```{r}
expr_cutoff <- 0.5
ref_pseud_path <- "~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Pseudobulks/HumanCompleteAtlas_AveragePseudobulk_ByCellType_26thMay2026.txt"
que_pseud_path <- "~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Pseudobulks/MarmosetCompleteAtlas_AveragePseudobulk_ByCellType_26thMay2026.txt"
ortholog_table <- "~/Scratch_MF/DownstreamAnalysis_2.7.11a/ReferenceFiles/Homology_1to1/HumanMarmoset_Homology_1to1_r105.txt"
ref_sp <- "Human"
que_sp <- "Marmoset"
ref_cl_excl <- NULL
que_cl_excl <- NULL
permutation_N <- 1000
cor.method <- "spearman"

## Loading pseudobulk 1, retaining only ensembl IDs, adding the species identifier, excluding genes with 0 counts
ref_pseudobulk <- read.table(file = ref_pseud_path)
ref_pseudobulk[ref_pseudobulk < expr_cutoff] <- 0
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk[,!(colnames(ref_pseudobulk) %in% ref_cl_excl)]
rownames(ref_pseudobulk) <- gsub(pattern = "-.*", replacement = '', x = rownames(ref_pseudobulk))
colnames(ref_pseudobulk) <- paste0(colnames(ref_pseudobulk), paste0("_", ref_sp))
to_remove <- rownames(ref_pseudobulk[rowSums(ref_pseudobulk) == 0,])
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk[!(rownames(ref_pseudobulk) %in% to_remove),]

## Loading pseudobulk 2, retaining only ensembl IDs, adding the species identifier, excluding genes with 0 counts
que_pseudobulk <- read.table(file = que_pseud_path)
que_pseudobulk[que_pseudobulk < expr_cutoff] <- 0
que_pseudobulk <- que_pseudobulk[,!(colnames(que_pseudobulk) %in% que_cl_excl)]
rownames(que_pseudobulk) <- gsub(pattern = "-.*", replacement = '', x = rownames(que_pseudobulk))
colnames(que_pseudobulk) <- paste0(colnames(que_pseudobulk), paste0("_", que_sp))
to_remove <- rownames(que_pseudobulk[rowSums(que_pseudobulk) == 0,])
que_pseudobulk <- que_pseudobulk[!(rownames(que_pseudobulk) %in% to_remove),]

## Loading the orthology reference table
one_to_one_list <- read.table(ortholog_table)
colnames(one_to_one_list) <- c("Reference.ensembl.ID", "Query.ensembl.ID", "Query.homology.type")

## Filtering out genes which are labeled as one_to_one but have more matches (ENSEMBL mistake)
index <- duplicated(one_to_one_list$Reference.ensembl.ID)
one_to_one_list <- one_to_one_list[!(index),]

## Retaining one-to-one orthologs only
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk %>% rownames_to_column() %>% dplyr::filter(rowname %in% one_to_one_list$Reference.ensembl.ID)
que_pseudobulk <- que_pseudobulk %>% rownames_to_column() %>% dplyr::filter(rowname %in% one_to_one_list$Query.ensembl.ID)

### Replace the query names with reference equivalents
que_pseudobulk <- left_join(que_pseudobulk, (one_to_one_list %>% dplyr::select(Reference.ensembl.ID, Query.ensembl.ID)), by = c("rowname" = "Query.ensembl.ID")) %>% dplyr::select(Reference.ensembl.ID, everything(), -rowname)

### Obtaining genes that are common to both species
genes_to_use <- intersect(ref_pseudobulk$rowname, que_pseudobulk$Reference.ensembl.ID)

## Filtering and reordering the genes in each pseudobulk
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk %>% dplyr::filter(rowname %in% genes_to_use) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "rowname")
que_pseudobulk <- que_pseudobulk %>% dplyr::filter(Reference.ensembl.ID %in% genes_to_use) %>% column_to_rownames("Reference.ensembl.ID")
que_pseudobulk <- que_pseudobulk[rownames(ref_pseudobulk),]
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk %>% rownames_to_column()
que_pseudobulk <- que_pseudobulk %>% rownames_to_column()

## Sanity check
test <- identical(rownames(ref_pseudobulk), rownames(que_pseudobulk))
if (test == TRUE) {
  print("Sanity check passed. Proceeding to plotting.")
} else {
  print("Sanity check failed. The pseudobulks do not contain the same genes/have a different order of genes. Exiting.")
  break()
}

## Merging and retaining the final pseudobulk
pseud_final <- left_join(ref_pseudobulk, que_pseudobulk) %>% column_to_rownames("rowname")
pseud_final <- pseud_final[,order(colnames(pseud_final))]
rm(que_pseudobulk, ref_pseudobulk)

## Final pseudobulk
pseud_final

## Loop over to compute correlations and extract relevant values
genes <- rownames(pseud_final)

df <- Reduce(rbind, lapply(1:permutation_N, function(sd){
  
    set.seed(sd)

    boot_genes <- sample(
      genes,
      size = length(genes),
      replace = TRUE
    )

    mat.boot <- pseud_final[boot_genes,]

    corr <- cor(mat.boot, method = cor.method)
    corr <- corr %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("rowname") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-rowname, names_to = "colnames", values_to = "correlation") %>%
  mutate(seed = sd)
    return(corr)
  }))

## Getting data to plot
to_plot <- df %>% mutate(rowname_cell_type = gsub(pattern = "_.*", replacement = "", x = rowname),
              colname_cell_type = gsub(pattern = "_.*", replacement = "", x = colnames),
              rowname_species = gsub(pattern = ".*_", replacement = "", x = rowname),
              colname_species = gsub(pattern = ".*_", replacement = "", x = colnames)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(colname_cell_type = case_when(colname_cell_type == "TrophProg" ~ "CTB", colname_cell_type == "InvTroph" ~ "EVT", .default = colname_cell_type)) %>%
  dplyr::select(rowname_species, rowname_cell_type, colname_species, colname_cell_type, correlation, seed) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowname_cell_type == colname_cell_type & rowname_species != colname_species) %>%
  dplyr::select(rowname_cell_type, correlation, seed) %>%
  unique()

## Converting to rate of evolution
to_plot$correlation <- 1 - to_plot$correlation

## Rearraning factors and adding labels to highlight trophoblasts
to_plot <- to_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rowname_cell_type = fct_reorder(rowname_cell_type, correlation, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Class = case_when(rowname_cell_type %in% c("STB") ~ "Syncytiotrophoblast",
                                                rowname_cell_type %in% c("fCTB", "cCTB", "CTB", "EVT") ~ "Other trophoblasts", 
                                                .default = "Non-trophoblast"))
to_plot$Class <- factor(to_plot$Class, levels = c("Syncytiotrophoblast", "Other trophoblasts", "Non-trophoblast"))

p1 <- ggplot(data = to_plot, aes(x = rowname_cell_type, y = correlation, fill = Class)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 37.5, hjust = 1, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 22), 
        legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("Divergence (1 - Spearman's rho)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Syncytiotrophoblast" = "#006400", "Other trophoblasts" = "#7FBF7B", "Non-trophoblast" = "#E3D3B3"))
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/a_", ref_sp, que_sp, "_RateOfEvolution_SpearmanRho_WithReplacement_nperm", permutation_N, "_cut", expr_cutoff, ".png"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/a_", ref_sp, que_sp, "_RateOfEvolution_SpearmanRho_WithReplacement_nperm", permutation_N, "_cut", expr_cutoff, ".pdf"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Concluding the session
rm(list = ls())
```

## Extended Figure 5c: Plotting rate of gene expression evolution from pseudobulks (with random resampling), expression cutoff = 0.5, human vs guinea pig

        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 37.5, hjust = 1, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 22), 
        legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("Divergence (1 - Spearman's rho)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Syncytiotrophoblast" = "#006400", "Other trophoblasts" = "#7FBF7B", "Non-trophoblast" = "#E3D3B3"))
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/c_", ref_sp, que_sp, "_RateOfEvolution_SpearmanRho_WithReplacement_nperm", permutation_N, "_cut", expr_cutoff, ".png"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/c_", ref_sp, que_sp, "_RateOfEvolution_SpearmanRho_WithReplacement_nperm", permutation_N, "_cut", expr_cutoff, ".pdf"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
